[SWS_DM_00159] Allow only to clear GroupOfAllDTCs
⌈
If the configu-
ration DiagnosticCommonProps.clearDtcLimitation is set to clearAllDtcs,
the Diagnostic Server instance shall only allow to clear all DTCs via the
GroupOfAllDTC as defined in [SWS_DM_00065]. In case a different value is given in
groupOfDTC request parameter, the Diagnostic Server instance shall return a
negative response 0x31 (RequestOutOfRange).
⌋
